<b>Pimpillo</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Red|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. Using it throws a bouncing projectile.

== Usefulness ==
The Pimpillo explodes either on contact with an [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemy]] or after its fuse has expended after 1.2 seconds, dealing [[Heavy Damage]].

The Pimpillo is a powerful explosive that works well at clearing out groups of enemies or dealing great damage within a small time span. However, due to its low capacity, it has a relatively low total damage output and can struggle to do meaningful damage to [[Bosses (Silksong)|bosses]].

Being in contact with the Pimpillo's explosion will immediately reverse the frosting effect on [[Mount Fay]] by 35%

== How to Acquire ==
Crafted at a crafting bench in [[Greymoor]] above [[Yarnaby|Yarnaby's]] home at a cost of {{C|1}}.

== Trivia ==
* Pimpillos can be used to obtain the [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entries of [[Muckmaggot]]s and [[Sandcarver]]s.
* If thrown into [[Groal the Great]]'s mouth during their <b>Great Inhale</b> attack, they will instead swallow the Pimpillo which explodes inside them.
* In the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pFAknD_9U7c <i>Hollow Knight: Silksong</i> reveal trailer], the Pimpillo's description noted that it is "dangerous to friends and foes alike"; however, the tool cannot harm any friends in the final game.
* The room which the Pimpillo is crafted has the same bags and red tents from [[Wisp Thicket]].
